title: Cover
description: The first slide of a pro deck: a large thin title that rises word by word out of its own line, a gold hairline and a thin gold circle that draws itself. With a picture or a clip it fills the right half and the words keep the left.

props.title: required, the name of the talk, 2-8 words
props.by: who and when, one short line at the bottom
props.src: a photo or mp4 for the right half
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of a face in the picture, 0 to 1
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the person
props.pos: object-position of the picture, for example 50% 30%

example.title: Motion graphics on a slide
example.sub: A real PowerPoint file, made from a few lines
